provenance.bbox_conversion: PyMuPDF source-page coordinates scaled to exact 180-DPI layout input image dimensions; every source render was verified to match.
provenance.label_scope: 149 accepted complete-table regions across 114 pages. Candidate review did not exhaustively label all tables on these pages; score known-positive recall only and do not score unmatched predictions as false positives. TBL-014 was excluded after full-page review identified a photograph, not a table.
provenance.split_policy: Issuer-level development/validation/locked_test split; locked_test was scored once on frozen baseline outputs and is not for tuning.
